summary: Execute an administrator-trusted standalone WASI Preview 1 command

400.description: Invalid input or unavailable runtime capacity

429.description: Upload or execution rate limit reached

description: Executes exact catalog bytes in a fixed disposable Node process, independently of Nginx HTTP filters. Explicit arguments/environment/stdin only; no inherited environment or preopened filesystem. At most two runs, 64 KiB inputs and 1 MiB combined normalized output. Timeout 100–60000 ms, default 10000 ms; client disconnect kills execution. No execution input/output is retained in audit records. node:wasi is not a security sandbox for hostile code.
